    theorem BrickAccessibility.accessibility_of_smaller (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] [FiniteDimensional k Λ] (hbasic : Statement.IsBasic k Λ) (hbf : Statement.IsBrickFinite Λ) (hA : ∀ (M : Type u) [inst : AddCommGroup M] [inst_1 : Module Λᵐᵒᵖ M] [inst_2 : Module k M] [inst_3 : IsScalarTower k Λᵐᵒᵖ M] [FiniteDimensional k M], Statement.IsBrick Λᵐᵒᵖ M → ¬IsSimpleModule Λᵐᵒᵖ M → Statement.HasSmallerBrick k Λ M) :
    (∀ (M : Type u) [inst : AddCommGroup M] [inst_1 : Module Λᵐᵒᵖ M] [inst_2 : Module k M] [inst_3 : IsScalarTower k Λᵐᵒᵖ M] [FiniteDimensional k M], Statement.IsBrick Λᵐᵒᵖ M → Statement.IsBrickAccessible k Λ M) ∧ (Nontrivial Λ → ∃ (N : ℕ), 1 ≤ N ∧ Statement.brickDimensions k Λ = Set.Icc 1 N)

    Brick accessibility and the interval of brick dimensions follow from the conclusion of Theorem A.
